description: A one-line block cannot close after a heredoc value, because a newline follows its closing marker
notes: The prose says a heredoc ends when its marker appears on a line of its own, and prose outranks the grammar's trailing Newline, so the newline after the marker belongs to the block and comes before the closing brace. hashicorp/hcl emits it as a separate token (heredocLiteralEOL in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl) and parser.finishParsingBodyBlock in hclsyntax/parser.go rejects it in a one-line block.
reference_error: which must also be closed on the same line
